owner: Ogero / Ministry of Telecommunications (public-private partnership; anchor tenants MIC1-Alfa, MIC2-Touch, Ogero)
notes: National data center announced by Ogero in 2018 as 'the first datacenter in Lebanon' (planned location Beirut area, not officially specified). Services planned: colocation-as-a-service, cloud, and disaster recovery. By Feb 2019 the PPP proposal was under final review by the privatization commission with execution expected spring 2019. No public evidence of construction after Lebanon's 2019+ economic crisis; status likely stalled/unbuilt.
